title: Design System: هرنس — Harness Deck System

body.purpose: Farsi prose, RTL, never gray — acid at 60%.

label.purpose: Latin technical labels and terminal output, always LTR.

motion.name: scene-ease
motion.purpose: 3D camera and car-part tweens between slide scenes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square acid-outline button; fills acid on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #F5D200; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #F5D200; padding: 16px 38px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease; border-radius: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F5D200; color: #1C1C1C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed rgba(245,210,0,0.6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Small metadata chip for slide headers.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid rgba(245,210,0,0.38); padding: 8px 18px; color: rgba(245,210,0,0.6); border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Drafting Callout
components.description: Dot + 84px leader line + label with mono sub-label; the world's signature annotation.
components.css: .ds-co { display: flex; align-items: center; direction: rtl; } .ds-co .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #F5D200; flex: none; } .ds-co .ds-ln { width: 84px; height: 1px; background: rgba(245,210,0,0.38); flex: none; } .ds-co .ds-tx { font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 600; color: #F5D200; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0 14px; } .ds-co .ds-tx small { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(245,210,0,0.6); direction: ltr; text-align: right; }

components.name: Deck Navigation
components.description: Fixed bottom-center chrome with RTL chevrons and Persian-digit counter.
components.html: ۰۱ / ۱۴
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; background: #1C1C1C; border: 1px solid rgba(245,210,0,0.16); padding: 10px 16px; direction: rtl; } .ds-nav button { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(245,210,0,0.38); color: #F5D200; width: 46px; height: 46px; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 0; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: #F5D200; color: #1C1C1C; } .ds-nav .ds-count { font-family: Vazirmatn, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #F5D200; min-width: 96px; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: Every slide is an engineering drawing sheet: a faint acid grid on near-black, registration crosses, drafting callouts, and one persistent 3D car rendered as a technical object — acid faces, ink edges, a drafting-grid floor. The binary palette is absolute; Farsi is the voice and the car drives in the direction of reading.
keyCharacteristics: Binary palette: acid on near-black, nothing else
Drafting vocabulary: callouts, dimension marks, title blocks, registration crosses
One persistent Three.js car across 14 choreographed scenes
Zero dependencies: single self-contained HTML file

rules.name: The Binary Rule
rules.body: No third color exists. Code syntax is expressed with weight, strikethrough, and opacity — never red or green.

dos: Do keep every color a tint of #F5D200 or #1C1C1C
Do set terminal/code runs LTR inside the RTL page
Do reuse the dot+leader callout for part annotations
donts: Don't add a third hue, rounded corners, or box shadows
Don't reflow slide content per device
Don't let copy sit on acid surfaces or labels on the acid car body
